summary: Closed the ISS-1 single-partition read-path parity slice with paging, tombstone warnings/failures, read-error golden fixtures, docs, and benchmark coverage.

details.notes: Validated `cargo test -p cassandra-server query_processor::tests::`, `server::tests::encode_query_result_sets_has_more_pages_and_returns_warnings`, `error_mapping::tests::{read_timeout_matches_golden_fixture,read_failure_matches_golden_fixture,tombstone_overwhelming_matches_golden_fixture}`, and `cargo bench -p cassandra-coordinator --bench read_path --no-run`. Distributed replica fan-out, digest mismatch serving-path integration, and range-read paging remain explicitly guarded and documented as the next cut.
